subject: Reconvene — Finomax account technical readout & next-step ledger
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Larsen <anna@finomax.com>, Finomax Support <support@finomax.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Reconvene — Finomax account technical readout & next-step ledger

Hi Anna / team,

Thanks again for your patience this morning. I wanted to follow up with a short, customer-facing readout and a proposed cadence for next steps. We experienced a partial degradation of tokenization and session state retrieval in your Dedicated pool that impacted a subset of requests between 07:22 and 07:49 UTC (approx. 27 minutes). The user-visible effect was an elevated rate of 502/timeout responses for long-sequence requests and a transient increase in latency for streaming responses.

Key points we will cover in the readout:
- Short timeline of what happened (root trigger + propagation).
- What we changed during the incident and why.
- Action items we are taking, owners, and expected completion windows.
- Deliverables we will share (evidence and validation checklist).

I attached a one-page findings summary for quick review (incident-findings-onepager.pdf) and would like to reconvene for a 45‑minute technical readout on Monday 2027-04-11 at 10:00am PT unless you prefer a different time. Proposed agenda in the attachment.

If there are any specific artifacts or proof points you need ahead of the readout (e.g., audit logs, KV cache snapshots, packet captures), please flag them and we’ll prioritize.

Sincerely,

David Kim
Senior Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: incident-findings-onepager.pdf

David —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager. The disruption impacted two production pipelines (billing reconciliation and customer notifications) and caused some retry storms on our side that required temporary throttling. We appreciate the quick mitigation earlier today.

Two asks before the readout:
1) Please confirm whether this incident will qualify under our SLA for credit. We need the incident window and the measurable impact criteria in writing.
2) We need evidence that customer data was not exposed and that no unauthorized reads occurred. A checklist of evidence you’ll provide ahead of the meeting would help our security team triage.

Can you include these items in the readout or send them prior? We can move the meeting if you need more time to collect artifacts.

Anna Larsen
Senior Engineering Manager, Finomax
anna@finomax.com

Anna — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses below and a short update on artifacts: 

1) SLA eligibility: We are compiling the exact incident window, affected endpoints, and request-level error counts. Based on our preliminary analysis this meets the threshold defined in section 4.2 of your SLA for degraded throughput impacting Dedicate d pool customers. We will deliver a formal SLA assessment document (including the calculation) by EOD 2027-04-11.

2) Evidence on data exposure: Our initial checks show no anomalous object reads or cross-namespace access. To be explicit: there are no signs of unauthorized retrievals of customer payloads. We will include the following artifacts for your security review:
- Auth audit log slice (timebound)
- KV-cache eviction and replication logs
- Signed checksums for a sample set of payloads processed during the window

Soojin is putting together the evidence pack and Marissa will coordinate the SLA calculation and formal wording for credits and remedial steps. We’ll upload the artifacts to the shared Drive and send a HubSpot link once ready.

Confirming the readout on Monday 2027-04-11 10:00am PT — we’ll send a calendar invite.

David

Subject: Final materials and action items — Finomax technical readout follow-up

Anna / Finomax team —

Thanks again for the time on Monday. As promised, the materials below are attached and uploaded to the shared folder (link included). Summary of what we delivered and next steps: 

Deliverables attached/uploaded:
- evidence-pack.zip (auth_audit_slice.csv, kv_evictions.log.gz, signed_payload_checksums.txt)
- action-owners-tracker.csv (owners and ETA for each remediation)

Executive summary (short):
- Root cause: a race during KV-cache reconciliation following a transient network partition in the Dedicated pool control plane. A small set of cache entries were marked stale and then rehydrated incorrectly, which led to session lookup failures for sequences > 8k tokens. The problem manifested as increased 502s and higher tail latency for affected requests.
- Containment: automatic rollback of the reconciliation job and targeted eviction of affected entries. That restored consistent session lookups across the pool within ~9 minutes after detection.

Action items and owners (high level):
1) Prevent recurrence — release a reconciliation robustness patch and add assertion checks (owner: Runtime Engineering; ETA: 2027-04-25).
2) Improve observability — add a reconciliation health metric and alert (owner: Platform Metrics; ETA: 2027-04-16).
3) SLA & credits — Marissa will prepare the formal SLA assessment and proposed credit calculation (owner: Marissa Cole; ETA: 2027-04-13).
4) Evidence & verification — our security team (Soojin) provided the evidence pack; please confirm receipt and any follow-up items (owner: Finomax security; ETA: 2027-04-15).

Next steps we need from Finomax:
- A quick confirmation on receipt of the evidence pack and whether you need any additional raw logs for forensic review.
- Confirmation on the acceptance window for the remediation schedule (if you prefer accelerated delivery for items 1–2, we can propose a faster timeline but may require a maintenance window).

I’m attaching the action-owners-tracker.csv and evidence-pack.zip to this message. If helpful, we can set up a short 30-minute working call this week to walk through the evidence and finalize the SLA language.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence-pack.zip, action-owners-tracker.csv
